title: Few-Shot Prompting
subtitle: Giving examples to steer output style and format

content.text: Including a few input-output examples in the prompt teaches the model the exact format and style you want.

content.code:
system = """Classify the sentiment of product reviews as POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, or NEUTRAL.

Examples:
Review: "This laptop is incredible, best purchase I've made!"
Sentiment: POSITIVE

Review: "Battery died after 2 months. Very disappointed."
Sentiment: NEGATIVE

Review: "It arrived on time and matches the description."
Sentiment: NEUTRAL
"""

user = 'Review: "The keyboard feels a bit mushy but I like the screen."'
# Model: NEUTRAL (or NEGATIVE depending on weighting)

content.text: Use 3–5 examples that cover edge cases. More is not always better — it uses up context.

questions.question: What is few-shot prompting?
options: Providing input-output examples in the prompt
questions.explanation: Few-shot prompting provides examples directly in the prompt to demonstrate the desired output format or style.

faq.a: Zero-shot has no examples — the model uses only instructions. Few-shot includes examples. Few-shot is more reliable for precise formats.
